generalization_boundary_matrix_gap: gap remains for unmeasured plugin-heavy documents, block patterns, selector graphs, invalidation fanout sizes, source branches, and owner-review environments
generalization_boundary_decision_rule: local decision may use the claim only with the exact replicated scope label and must block broader recommendation text until transfer evidence is present
supported_claim: the current artifact supports benchmark causality, not source-patch safety
blocked_claim: a selector/source patch is safe because aggregate timing improves
pass_result: repeat: residual-uncertainty-axis already checked
